scope: Own-momentum oil amendment; two-episode technical preflight then remaining18 only on technical pass; no validation or live promotion.
collection_notes: class_momentum1h is the unchanged native source/original-study verifier baseline, not a replacement for the peer research candidate. Store and verify its original study before the separate frozen full-exit analysis.
feature_rule: First fresh opening snapshot within60s; at5..55min use prior fresh observations age<=60s; decision new quote in[60min,60min+5s). All13 required for range/spread. Initial R=full observed first-hour mid range through decision, rounded to grid. No path-efficiency filter.
peer_rule: Other crude only, same source start, opening snapshot within60s, last observed fresh quote as-of decision age<=60s; continuation of peer first-hour sign; target excluded; next-quote direction recheck. Flat peer is a legitimate skip; missing peer is a data gap.
fill_rule: Next strictly later fresh quote before minute60+5s, sides age<=6s; recheck own/peer direction at fill. At most one entry per rule/symbol/date. No interpolation.
target_and_exit_rule: Existing Rust Q=1.38 targets::plan; originalR stop; original native quantity; native partial/whole minimum handling; fixed-stop control versus existing S3ThirtySeconds original-R trail, next-quote acknowledgement, old broker bracket first; no trail proposals final30min.
boundary_rule: Hour4 deadline, first executable quote in five-second tail; otherwise retain censoring.

costs.spread: median of13 causal observed bid/ask spreads
costs.commission_status: unknown; explicit zero-additional-fee sensitivity only, never calibrated net
costs.cost_veto: C>=R at decision or fill skips; no threshold tuning
costs.sensitivity_note: Hold entries, geometry and exits fixed across cost sensitivities. 2 and3.74bp are optimistic diagnostics, not calibrated fees;24 is existing stress assumption. Executable spread charged once. Weighted exits include every partial fill.

development_gates.zero_loss_case: At least one positive win with zero losses passes the profit/loss comparison; display PF as unavailable/no losses, never invent infinity.
development_gates.incremental_peer_gate: Descriptive unchanged peer control; no fallback. Primary own-momentum requires positive matched trailing24bp mean R difference versus always_long, for class and each symbol; matched pairs must be nonempty.
development_gates.selection: No parameter, date, quantity, cost, horizon, symbol or exit-arm selection after outcomes. Only the preregistered primary24bp trailing candidate can advance; sensitivities are descriptive.
development_gates.coverage: Missing preparation/decision/fill/peer/end evidence, failed source, censored exits and native reported data_issues fail the screen; unproven historical specifications/costs remain separate financial qualification gaps.

validation.warning: Some historical bars/baseline dates were previously visible; this is separate-time candidate evaluation, not a pristine holdout. Every class and symbol result remains visible. No retuning on validation.
validation.opening_condition: Not opened by this adapter, even if development passes. Report eligibility only; preserve earlier conditions and qualify costs/history/shadow before promotion.

preflight.broker_historical_availability: NOT_VERIFIABLE until attempted; no historical request made in this delivery
preflight.prior_global_data_exposure: NOT_VERIFIABLE; additional development, not a pristine holdout
preflight.contract_mapping: Require exact source symbol/account/native volume/grid and captured contract; no substitution. Current snapshot does not certify historical specification.
preflight.existing_job: Do not replace another running job.
preflight.request_ownership: Expected request and job id must match every poll; stop on replacement/restart/mismatch.
preflight.acceptance: First exact date pair complete with both tick sides, bounded in-window ticks, correct current contract and native original-study parity; full-exit preparation/entry/exit has no missing/censored evidence. Valid cost veto/flat/change skips are allowed. Native continuity flags remain visible and fail the development screen but alone do not assert a collection protocol failure.

retention: Save only one immutable source receipt/file per planned episode, collection/analysis hashes and derived results; local bounded research storage, not new production database telemetry. No ZIP or duplicate tick archive.
stop_conditions: Stop submission on source/hash/account/contract mismatch or another active job.
Record unavailable/censored episodes and fail the gate; do not replace their dates.
Stop at20submitted jobs even if sample/gates fail; no collect-until-win loop.
Reject or mark insufficient if primary/per-symbol/coverage gates fail; validation remains unopened.
No automatic fee reduction, risk increase, strategy promotion or worker-policy change.
Preflight technical failure stops remaining18; save failure evidence without automatic retries.
Indeterminate POST/reservation or incomplete saved job requires inspection; never automatically resubmit.
financial_qualification: NOT_VERIFIABLE: current cost assessment has no qualified paired round trips; development is scenario research only.
